blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A correct diagnosis reached from insufficient or misleading evidence can pose a clinical hazard, yet outcome-based accuracy may reward such lucky guesses. We call this mismatch between diagnostic decisions and the value of available evidence Evidence-Value Misalignment ( EVM ) . To disentangle evidential grounding independently from diagnostic accuracy, we introduce MedEVM , a dynamic benchmarking environment comprising 1,050 cases across 24 disease systems. Observations arrive turn by turn, requiring models to continuously calibrate its decision by deciding whether to wait for more evidence or submit a diagnosis. Across 9 LLMs, four interesting patterns are observed. (1) Miscalibrated evidence tracking . Making a diagnosis often fails to calibrate evidence sufficiency, even in more capable models, and even worsens in reasoning mode. (2) Misaligned diagnosis submission . Confidence in the correct diagnosis often fails to ensure timely submission despite sufficient evidence. (3) Evidence order matters . Reordering the same evidence changes diagnoses even when model confidence remains similar. (4) Misleading evidence remains influential. Added misleading evidence redirects diagnoses even after prior evidence becomes sufficient. We further verify that EVM predicts errors and that preventing premature submission improves accuracy. These findings motivate Evidence-Verified Diagnosis Harness ( EVD-Harness ) . It decouples diagnosis generation from submission through an offline Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki and three online control stages, namely observation management, proposal and witness verification, and diagnosis submission control. Across five LLMs, EVD-Harness improves accuracy by 12.0–51.1 percentage points while mitigating EVM-related failures. Our results demonstrate that verifying evidential support before submission can make diagnostic decisions more reliable.
blocks.zh: 从证据不足或误导性证据中得出的正确诊断可构成临床危险,但基于结果的准确性可能奖励这种幸运的猜测。 我们称之为诊断决定与现有证据价值之间的不匹配。 为了将证据与诊断准确性分开,我们引入了MedEVM,这是一个动态的基准环境,由24个疾病系统的1,050个病例组成。 观察结果依次提交,要求模型通过决定是否等待更多证据或提交诊断,不断调整其决定。 在9个法学硕士课程中,观察到四个有趣的模式。 (1)错误的证据跟踪. 做出诊断往往无法校准证据的充分性,即使在能力更强的模型中也是如此,在推理模式中甚至会恶化. (2) 诊断呈文不一致。 尽管证据充分,但对正确诊断的信心往往无法确保及时提交。 (3) 证据命令事项。 重排相同的证据会改变诊断,即使模型置信度仍然相似. (4) 误导证据仍然具有影响力。 增加的误导性证据会改变诊断方向,即使在以前的证据已经足够了。 我们进一步核实EVM预测错误,防止过早提交会提高准确性. 这些调查结果激发了证据验证的诊断机理(EVD-Harness). 它通过离线对比诊断Wiki和三个在线控制阶段,即观察管理、建议和证人核实以及诊断提交控制,使诊断生成与提交脱钩。 在五个LLMs中,EVD-Harness的精度提高了12.0-51.1个百分点,同时减轻了EVM相关故障. 我们的结果表明,在提交之前核实证据支持可以使诊断决定更加可靠。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) show strong reasoning capabilities on difficult medical questions and complex cases ( Singhal et al., 2023 ) . To evaluate these capabilities beyond static medical QA ( Jin et al., 2021 ; Pal et al., 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) , AgentClinic ( Schmidgall et al., 2024 ) , AI Hospital ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , and MediQ ( Li et al., 2024 ) introduce multi-turn diagnostic interactions in which models gather patient information and refine diagnoses, bringing evaluation closer to real clinical encounters. EHRWorld ( Mu et al., 2026 ) and ChronoMedicalWorld ( Wang et al., 2026 ) further extend these interactive settings by modeling how patient states evolve under clinical interventions.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)在困难的医疗问题和复杂病例上表现出强大的推理能力(Singhal等人,2023年) . 在静态医疗质量保证之外评估这些能力(Jin等人,2021年;Pal等人,2022年;Zhu等人,2026年)。 (Schmidgall等人,2024年),AI医院(Fan等人,2025年)和MediQ (Li等人,2024年)引入多回合诊断相互作用,模型在其中收集病人信息并完善诊断,使评价更接近于真正的临床遭遇. EHRWorld(Mu等人,2026年)和ChronoMedical World(Wang等人,2026年)通过模拟病人状态在临床干预下的演化,进一步扩大了这些互动环境.

blocks.zh: 图1:MDEVM概览. 最终准确性本身掩盖了模型提交诊断时的差异. 在MedEVM中,临床证据会轮流到达,LLM代理必须等待或提交诊断. 这一评价揭示了四个关键结果,通过只回答评分来隐藏。

blocks.en: Yet increasingly realistic clinical environments do not make final diagnostic accuracy a sufficient measure of clinical reasoning. Accuracy-based evaluation treats a correct diagnosis submitted on insufficient evidence the same as one supported by sufficient evidence, leaving the evidential basis for submission unexamined. Although recent work has examined vulnerabilities in multi-turn settings and premature diagnosis submission ( Laban et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Hsu et al., 2026 ) , a fundamental question remains: Do LLMs appropriately weigh the available evidence when deciding to submit a diagnosis? Here, evidence value refers to an observation’s ability to narrow the differential diagnosis and inform whether the available evidence warrants submission.
blocks.zh: 然而,越来越现实的临床环境并没有使最终诊断准确性成为衡量临床推理的充分尺度。 以准确性为基础的评价处理在证据不足的情况下提交的正确诊断,与有充足证据支持的诊断相同,使提交的证据基础得不到审查。 虽然最近的工作审查了多回合环境下的脆弱性和过早诊断的提交(Laban等人,2026年;Fang等人,2026年;Hsu等人,2026年),但一个根本问题仍然是: LLMS在决定提交诊断时是否适当权衡现有证据? 在这方面,证据价值是指观察能够缩小差别诊断,并告知现有证据是否值得提交。

blocks.en: To answer this question, we introduce MedEVM , a progressive-evidence diagnosis benchmark comprising 1,050 cases across 24 disease systems (Section 3 ). Each case consists of an ordered sequence of atomic observations extracted from a case report, a gold diagnosis, and nine plausible alternative diagnoses. After each observation, the model must decide whether to wait for more evidence or submit a diagnosis. We annotate the sufficiency boundary t ∗ t^{*} as the earliest turn at which the accumulated evidence is sufficient to distinguish the gold diagnosis from all alternatives. We define Evidence-Value Misalignment (EVM) as a mismatch between when a model submits a diagnosis and when the available evidence becomes sufficient to support that submission.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这个问题,我们引入了MedEVM, 由24个疾病系统的1,050个病例组成的渐进证据诊断基准(第3节)。 每个病例包括从病例报告中提取的有序原子观测序列,金质诊断,以及9种可行的替代诊断. 每次观察后,模型必须决定是等待更多的证据,还是提交诊断. 我们指出,充分边界t t t ^{*}是最早的转折,在此过程中,积累的证据足以区分金诊断和所有替代品。 我们把证据价值错配定义为模型提交诊断时与现有证据足以支持其提交时之间的不匹配。

blocks.en: Controlled experiments across nine LLMs reveal four EVM patterns (Section 4 ). (1) Miscalibrated evidence tracking . Making a diagnosis often fails to calibrate evidence sufficiency, even in more capable models, and even worsens in reasoning mode. (2) Misaligned diagnosis submission . Confidence in the correct diagnosis often fails to ensure timely submission despite sufficient evidence. (3) Evidence order matters. Diagnostic decisions are sensitive to evidence order, even when model confidence remains similar. (4) Misleading evidence remains influential. Added misleading observations can redirect diagnoses regardless of whether prior evidence was sufficient.
blocks.zh: 九个LLMs的受控实验揭示了四种EVM模式(第4节). (1)错误的证据跟踪. 做出诊断往往无法校准证据的充分性,即使在能力更强的模型中也是如此,在推理模式中甚至会恶化. (2) 诊断呈文不一致。 尽管证据充分,但对正确诊断的信心往往无法确保及时提交。 (3) 证据命令事项。 诊断性决定对证据令很敏感,即使模型信心仍然相似. (4) 误导证据仍然具有影响力。 添加的误导性意见可以重新确定诊断方向,无论先前的证据是否充分。

blocks.en: We next examine whether EVM helps explain diagnostic decisions and errors (Section 5 ). Measures of evidence valuation provide information beyond model confidence for predicting when models submit a diagnosis and whether that diagnosis is correct. We then test the effect of correcting premature submission using Natural Gate , an oracle intervention that defers submission until the annotated sufficiency boundary t ∗ t^{*} . Among cases in which models originally submitted before t ∗ t^{*} , this intervention improves accuracy by 29.6–48.4 percentage points.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们审查EVM是否帮助解释诊断决定和错误(第5节)。 证据估价措施提供了超出模型信任范围的信息,用于预测模型何时提交诊断以及诊断是否正确. 然后,我们用自然门检验纠正过早提交的影响,这一先知干预将提交推迟到附加说明的充分性边界 t 。 在最初在 t 之前提交模型的案例中,这种干预提高了29.6至48.4个百分点的准确性。

blocks.en: These findings motivate the Evidence-Verified Diagnosis Harness ( EVD-Harness ), which separates diagnosis generation from submission using an offline Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki and three online control stages (Section 6 ). Observation management organizes incoming evidence and retrieves relevant diagnostic knowledge. Proposal and witness verification generates candidate diagnoses and checks the evidence supporting them. Diagnosis submission control validates the cited evidence before allowing a diagnosis to be submitted. Across five LLMs, EVD-Harness improves diagnostic accuracy by 12.0–51.1 percentage points while reducing EVM-related failures. These results show why valuing the right evidence should be evaluated separately from producing the right answer. Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 这些结论激励了证据验证诊断方法(EVD-Harness),它利用离线对比诊断维基和三个在线控制阶段(第6节)将诊断生成与提交区分开来。 观察管理组织接收证据,检索相关诊断知识. 提名和证人的核实使候选人能够诊断和检查支持他们的证据。 诊断提交控制在允许提交诊断之前验证了上述证据。 在五个LLMs中,EVD-Harness将诊断精度提高了12.0-51.1个百分点,同时减少了EVM相关故障. 这些结果表明,为什么对正确证据的评价应与提出正确答案分开。 我们的贡献有三个方面:

blocks.en: • We introduce MedEVM , a progressive-evidence benchmark that evaluates diagnosis submission against annotated evidence sufficiency, revealing failures that final diagnostic accuracy alone cannot capture. • We identify Evidence-Value Misalignment (EVM) through controlled analyses of submission timing and responses to reordered and misleading evidence. We show that EVM measures help identify diagnostic errors, while delaying premature submission improves accuracy. • We develop EVD-Harness , which separates diagnosis generation from submission control, better aligning submission with evidence sufficiency and improving diagnostic accuracy.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Dynamic Medical Diagnosis Benchmarks. Static benchmarks such as MedQA ( Jin et al., 2021 ) , MedMCQA ( Pal et al., 2022 ) , and PubMedQA ( Jin et al., 2019 ) evaluate medical knowledge and final answers from fully presented contexts, but cannot reveal how diagnosis evolves as evidence arrives. Recent benchmarks instead model diagnosis as a dynamic process. DDXPlus ( Fansi Tchango et al., 2022 ) supports symptom-seeking differential diagnosis, while AgentClinic ( Schmidgall et al., 2024 ) , AI Hospital ( Fan et al., 2025 ) , and MMD-Eval ( Liu et al., 2025 ) simulate consultations that involve patients, examinations, or tools. MediQ ( Li et al., 2024 ) evaluates proactive acquisition of missing information. MINT ( Fang et al., 2026 ) reveals fixed evidence over turns to study rushing, lures, and self-correction, while MedEinst ( Chen et al., 2026 ) uses counterfactual cases to expose shortcut-driven errors hidden by endpoint accuracy. Complementary to these efforts, MedEVM treats neither dialogue quality nor the final answer as the sole endpoint. It aligns turn-level belief and natural wait-or-answer behavior with an externally annotated earliest sufficiency boundary, then uses controlled interventions to test how misalignment changes diagnostic outcomes.
blocks.zh: 动态医学诊断基准。 静态基准,如MedQA(Jin等人,2021年),MedMCQA (Pal等人,2022年),PubMedQA(Jin等人,2019年)从充分呈现的背景评价医学知识和最终答案,但无法揭示诊断如何随着证据的到来而演变. 最近的基准将诊断作为一种动态过程。 DDXPlus(Fansi Tchango等人,2022年)支持寻求症状的差别诊断,而AgentClinic(Schmidgall等人,2024年),AI医院(Fan等人,2025年),MMD-Eval(Liu等人,2025年)模拟涉及病人,检查,或工具的咨询. 菜单 (Li等人,2024年)评价主动获取缺失信息. MINT(Fang et al., 2026年)披露了固定的证据转弯来研究匆忙,诱骗,以及自我纠正,而MedEinst(Chen et al., 2026年)则使用反事实案例来揭露以端点准确性隐藏的捷径驱动错误. 作为对这些努力的补充,MDEVM既不把对话质量,也不把最后的答案作为唯一的终点。 它将转动的信仰和自然的等待或回答行为与外部注释的最早的充足性边界相协调,然后使用可控的干预来测试错位如何改变诊断结果.

blocks.en: From Uncertainty Estimation to Diagnosis Submission Control. Prior work estimates answer reliability through model self-evaluation, black-box confidence elicitation, and semantic uncertainty ( Kadavath et al., 2022 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Farquhar et al., 2024 ) . Selective prediction converts such scores into answer-or-abstain decisions ( Kamath et al., 2020 ) , and MedAbstain ( Machcha et al., 2026 ) extends this framework to medical MCQA under missing or perturbed context. For sequential agents, KnowNo ( Ren et al., 2023 ) forms conformal action sets and requests help when the next action is not uniquely supported. Closest to our failure setting, Handler et al. (2026) evaluate premature closure as inappropriate diagnosis submission under uncertainty. These approaches provide important reliability tools, but answer confidence is not equivalent to clinical evidence sufficiency. A model may submit a diagnosis early with high confidence or keep waiting after it becomes uniquely identifiable. We therefore treat diagnosis submission as an evidence-conditioned decision distinct from answer generation. This framing motivates mitigation that reduces premature submission without merely replacing it with delayed answers or persistent abstention.
blocks.zh: 从不确定估计到诊断提交控制. 先前的工作估计通过模型自我评价、黑箱置信和语义不确定性来回答可靠性问题(Kadavath等人,2022年;Xiong等人,2024年;Farquhar等人,2024年)。 选择性预测将此类分数转换为答案或吸收决定(Kamath等人,2020年),MedAbstain(Machcha等人,2026年)将这一框架扩展至缺失或扰动上下文下的医疗MCQA. 对于顺序代理,KnowNo(Ren等人,2023年)会形成一致的动作集,并在下一个动作没有独有支持时请求帮助. 接近于我们的失败设定,Handler等人(2026年)评价过早结束是在不确定的情况下不适当的诊断提交. 这些方法提供了重要的可靠性工具,但回答信心并不等同于临床证据的充分性. 一个模型可能很早就以高度的自信提交诊断,或者在它变得独特可识别后继续等待. 因此,我们把提交诊断视为一个有证据依据的决定,不同于生成答案。 这一框架有助于减缓过早提交问题,而不只是以延迟答复或持续弃权取代。

blocks.en: 3 Dynamic MedEVM Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 动态 MedeVM 基准

blocks.en: To systematically evaluate whether LLMs can align diagnosis submission with incrementally available evidence, we introduce MedEVM , a progressive-evidence diagnosis benchmark that simulates a dynamic clinical environment by revealing atomic observations from case reports in sequential turns, and records when LLMs wait, submit a diagnosis, or revise their diagnostic beliefs.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评估LLMS是否能够将诊断提交与递增的现有证据相一致,我们引入了MedEVM, 这是一种渐进式证据诊断基准,通过依次从病例报告中披露原子观测结果,模拟动态临床环境,以及LLMs等待、提交诊断或修改诊断信仰时的记录。

blocks.en: We collect case reports from PubMed-indexed journals ( White, 2020 ) , covering NEJM, BMJ Case Reports, Gastroenterology, JAMA, and The Lancet. After applying formatting and completeness filters, we retain 36,020 reports that contain a confirmed diagnosis and sufficient clinical information. We next remove diagnostic leakage, segment each narrative into typed atomic evidence in chronological order, and treat the confirmed diagnosis as ground truth. Using a structured prompt, GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026a ) generates nine clinically plausible confounders for each case. Three proprietary models from different families, namely Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ( Gemini Team, 2026a ) , and GPT-5.6-sol ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , independently annotate the sufficiency boundary t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} , and we keep only cases with unanimous boundary annotations. Finally, Gemini 3.5 Flash ( Gemini Team, 2026b ) and five graduate students with medical backgrounds jointly verify the quality of each sample, resulting in 1,050 cases for the final MedEVM benchmark. Details can be found in Appendix A1 .

blocks.en: We examine EVM in medical diagnosis through four progressive experiments on its prevalence and mechanisms. These characterize diagnosis submission timing, probe diagnostic knowledge, test evidence order, and vary misleading evidence strength.
blocks.zh: 我们在医学诊断中通过对它的流行程度和机制的四项渐进实验来检查EVM. 这些特征是诊断提交时间、探测诊断知识、测试证据顺序,以及不同误导性证据强度。

blocks.en: We categorize trajectories by whether the model submits a diagnosis before, at, or after the sufficiency boundary t ∗ t^{*} , or remains unanswered after all evidence arrives. Figure 3 compares model sizes, similar-capacity versions, and model families. We also enable thinking mode in seven models to test whether additional reasoning improves diagnosis submission timing.
blocks.zh: 我们按模型是否在充分边界 t 之前、之时或之后提交诊断结果来分类,或者在所有证据到达之后仍未得到答复。 图3比较了模型大小,类似容量版本,以及模型家族. 我们还使7个模型中的思维模式能够测试额外推理是否改善了诊断提交时间.

blocks.en: All nine models exhibit substantial EVM, with capability gains changing its form rather than steadily reducing it. Qwen3-8B submits early in 99.1% of cases, whereas larger and later LLMs reduce early submission but often wait despite sufficient evidence or never answer. These patterns persist when submissions within one or two turns of the annotated boundary are treated as aligned (Appendix A3.2 ). Thinking increases early submission to 94.1–99.7% across seven models under the strict boundary, showing that additional reasoning can reinforce premature diagnosis submission.
blocks.zh: 所有9种模型都显示出大量的EVM,能力增益改变了其形式,而不是稳步减少。 Qwen3-8B在99.1%的案件中提前提交,而较大和较晚的有限责任公司则减少提前提交,但往往不顾充分证据等待,或从未答复。 如果在附加说明的边界一两个转弯内提交的划界案被视为对齐(附录A3.2.),这些模式就继续存在。 在严格边界下,七种模型的早期提交率增加到94.1-99.7%,这表明额外的推理可以强化过早诊断的提交。

blocks.en: Takeaway : Models exhibit EVM: diagnosis submission timing is misaligned with evidence sufficiency. Greater capability does not eliminate it, and reasoning mode worsens it.
blocks.zh: Takeaway:模型显示EVM:诊断提交时间与证据充足性不符. 更大的能力并不能消除它,推理模式使其恶化.

Since submitting a diagnosis terminates the diagnostic trajectory, boundary statistics include only trajectories remaining active at t ∗ t^{*} . We also conduct a thinking-mode sensitivity analysis for seven models and report expected calibration error (ECE). We group N N predictions into M M equal-width confidence bins B m B_{m} using the highest candidate probability. Then ECE = ∑ m = 1 M | B m | N ​ | acc ⁡ ( B m ) − conf ⁡ ( B m ) | \mathrm{ECE}=\sum_{m=1}^{M}\frac{|B_{m}|}{N}|\operatorname{acc}(B_{m})-\operatorname{conf}(B_{m})| , where acc \operatorname{acc} and conf \operatorname{conf} are the accuracy and mean confidence within each bin. Lower ECE indicates more reliable confidence (Appendix A3 ).

blocks.en: For each case, we reorder only the clinical evidence presented before t ∗ t^{*} without changing any evidence content. The evidence at t ∗ t^{*} and all subsequent evidence retain their original order. Both sequences provide identical evidence sets at t ∗ t^{*} . Diagnosis outcome disagreement occurs when the two trajectories submit different diagnoses, or one answers while the other remains unanswered. For pairs reaching t ∗ t^{*} in both orders, we compare probability distributions over the ten candidate diagnoses using Jensen–Shannon divergence (JSD). Lower JSD indicates more similar beliefs, with zero denoting identical distributions. For each metric, we average across permutations within each case and then across cases.

Among pairs reaching t ∗ t^{*} in both orders, mean JSD is low (0.009–0.044), yet substantial outcome disagreement remains (Figure 5 , right). Thus, the evidence sequence affects final diagnoses even when both trajectories reach sufficient evidence and yield similar diagnostic beliefs (Appendix A3 ).

blocks.en: Takeaway : Simply reordering the same evidence changes diagnosis outcomes despite similar diagnostic beliefs at the sufficiency boundary. Evidence order therefore affects how models act on available information.

blocks.en: We use two paired interventions to manipulate evidence value. First, we insert repeated clinical evidence or clinically irrelevant text into each case to test whether additions without new diagnostic information change diagnostic beliefs or decisions. Second, for 318 cases, we select an incorrect candidate diagnosis as the target diagnosis . We construct weak and strong misleading evidence that differ in their support for this target while matching the evidence type, semantic direction, and format. We insert the paired versions at the same position early in the diagnostic trajectory, one turn before t ∗ t^{*} , or one turn after t ∗ t^{*} , with turns indexed in the augmented sequence. Target belief is the probability assigned to the incorrect target diagnosis, tracking confidence in this misleading alternative.
blocks.zh: 我们用两种对齐的干预来操纵证据价值. 首先,我们在每个病例中插入重复的临床证据或临床无关的文字,以检验没有新的诊断信息而添加的内容是否改变诊断信仰或决定. 第二,对于318个病例,我们选择不正确的候选人诊断作为目标诊断。 我们构建了薄弱和强烈的误导性证据,这些证据在支持这一目标方面各不相同,同时与证据类型、语义方向和格式相匹配。 在诊断轨迹的早期,我们在同一位置插入配对版本,在t * t 之前一个转动,或者在t * t 之后一个转动,转动按增强序列进行索引。 目标信念是指定给错误的目标诊断的概率,跟踪这种误导性选择的信心.

blocks.en: 5 Why EVM Matters: Predicting and Preventing Errors
blocks.zh: EVM为何重要:预测和预防错误

blocks.en: The value of EVM extends beyond describing model behavior. We test whether its features help predict submission timing and assess diagnostic errors, and whether reducing EVM improves accuracy.
blocks.zh: EVM的价值超越了描述模型行为. 我们测试其特征是否有助于预测提交时间和评估诊断错误,以及减少EVM是否提高准确性。

blocks.en: We separate two prediction tasks: whether the next action submits a diagnosis after a wait , and whether a diagnosis is incorrect at its submission turn. The first uses checkpoints with an observed next turn, while the second uses each first submission. For each LLM, we fit regularized logistic regression with shared case-level splits and balance both classes within each split by majority-class undersampling. Baseline M1 uses (1) the fraction of evidence received, (2) evidence and candidate counts, and (3) diagnostic confidence, summarizing certainty across candidates. Our M3 adds (4) diagnosis submission propensity, capturing the tendency to submit rather than wait, and (5) belief instability, capturing changes in confidence between turns. AUROC ( Peterson et al., 1954 ) measures how well predictions distinguish submission from waiting, or incorrect from correct diagnoses, respectively. For next-turn submission, log loss (LL) evaluates predicted submission probabilities. A negative Δ ​ LL = LL M ​ 3 − LL M ​ 1 \Delta\mathrm{LL}=\mathrm{LL}_{M3}-\mathrm{LL}_{M1} indicates better estimates of next-turn submission probabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们分开两个预测任务:下一个行动是否在等待之后提出诊断,以及诊断在提交时是否不正确。 第一组使用检查点,下一组则观察到,第二组则使用每次提交。 对于每个LLM,我们通过共同的个案级划分来适应正常的物流回归,并在每个分类中平衡两种类别,并进行多数级的抽样。 M1基线使用(1) 收到的证据的比例,(2) 证据和候选人数,以及(3) 诊断信心,总结候选人的确定性。 我们的M3增加了(4) 诊断提交倾向,捕捉提交而不是等待的倾向,以及(5) 信仰不稳定,捕捉到转弯之间的信心变化。 AUROC(Peterson等人,1954年)分别衡量预测如何将屈服与等待区分开来,或判断错误与正确。 对于下一轮提交,日志损失(LL)评估了预测的提交概率。 负 LL = LL M 3 – LL M 1\Delta\ mathrm{LL}=\ mathrm{LL}_{M3}-\mathrm{LL}_{M1}表示下一轮提交概率的更好估计.

blocks.en: M3 improves AUROC for seven of nine LLMs in each task (Table 7 ). Pooled AUROC rises from 0.835 to 0.854 for next-turn submission and from 0.845 to 0.879 for submission errors. EVM features thus inform both submission timing and error assessment beyond confidence alone. Next-turn log loss improves for eight models, with full baseline comparisons in Appendix A4 .

blocks.en: To test whether reducing EVM changes diagnostic outcomes, we apply Natural Gate to cases where the model originally answers before t ∗ t^{*} . Natural Gate replaces every attempted diagnosis submission before t ∗ t^{*} with wait , allowing further evidence to arrive. At t ∗ t^{*} , we remove the gate and restore the original action prompt. The model then decides whether to wait or submit a diagnosis using the accumulated evidence. Among all intervened cases, 32.9–50.5% change from failure to success, while far fewer change in the opposite direction (Figure 7 ). blocks.en: 6 EVD-Harness : Evidence-Verified Diagnosis Harness

blocks.en: Our EVM analyses reveal premature diagnosis submission and waiting after decisive evidence arrives. EVD-Harness decouples diagnosis generation from submission through an offline contrastive diagnostic Wiki and three online modules: evidence management, proposal and witness verification, and diagnosis submission control. Together, they manage the context and calls of a frozen LLM, using retrieved knowledge to guide diagnosis and current evidence to authorize its submission.

blocks.en: 6.1 Offline Diagnostic Wiki Construction
blocks.zh: 6.1 离线诊断 维基构建

blocks.en: The Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki (CDW) organizes clinical experience around findings that distinguish confusable diseases. We deduplicate published case reports using document identifiers and text similarity, excluding sources associated with MedEVM , MedXpertQA, DiagnosisArena, and other existing benchmarks, including rewrites and derived questions. An LLM extracts the final diagnosis, competing diagnoses, shared presentations, and the findings used by the report authors to distinguish them. It retains the supporting passages and removes identifying details such as names and hospitals. Independent review checks each explanation against its supporting source passage. The resulting Wiki contains linked disease pages, test pages, and contrastive bridges . Each bridge records confusable diseases, their shared presentation, a distinguishing finding, and its clinical context. Related entries are consolidated with source references into a Wiki fixed for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 对照诊断Wiki(CDW)组织临床体验,围绕区分可混淆疾病的发现. 我们利用文件标识符和文本相似性来复制已公布的案例报告,但不包括与MedEVM、MedXpertQA、DiagnosisArena有关的来源,以及包括改写和衍生问题在内的其他现有基准。 LLM 提取最终诊断,相互竞争的诊断,共享的演示文稿,以及报告作者用来区分他们的结论. 它保留了辅助段落,删除了姓名和医院等识别细节。 独立审查检查每个解释与支持源的通过。 由此产生的Wiki包含链接的疾病页面,测试页面,以及对比性桥梁. 每座桥记录了可混淆的疾病、共同的介绍、不同的发现及其临床背景。 相关条目与来源引用合并成一个用于评价的Wiki.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MedEVM , a progressive-evidence benchmark of 1,050 cases that evaluates diagnosis submission against annotated evidence sufficiency. Across nine LLMs, we identify EVM as a misalignment between diagnosis submission timing and evidence sufficiency. Even when models recognize the correct diagnosis, evidence order and misleading evidence redirect submission decisions. Scaling and thinking do not consistently resolve this mismatch. We then validate its diagnostic relevance through prediction and intervention: EVM signals impending errors, and preventing premature submission improves accuracy. To address this mismatch, we develop EVD-Harness , which retrieves contrastive diagnostic knowledge to guide diagnosis proposals, then authorizes submission through independent evidence review and citation checks. Across five LLMs, it improves accuracy by 12.0–51.1 percentage points and reduces sensitivity to evidence perturbations.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了MedEVM, 即1 050个案例的渐进证据基准, 在9个有限责任公司中,我们发现EVM是诊断提交时间和证据充足性之间的错配。 即使模型承认正确的诊断,证据命令和误导性证据也会改变提交决定的方向. 扩大和思考不能持续地解决这种不匹配。 然后,我们通过预测和干预验证其诊断相关性:EVM信号即将出现错误,防止过早提交会提高准确性。 为了解决这一不匹配问题,我们开发了EVD-Harness(EVD-Harness),它检索了对比性诊断知识来指导诊断建议,然后授权通过独立的证据审查和引用检查提交. 在五个有限责任公司中,精确度提高了12.0-51.1个百分点,降低了对证据扰动的敏感性。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: First, MedEVM is built from published case reports, so its disease distribution does not represent routine clinical prevalence. Broader sampling across care settings would strengthen external validity. Second, fixed candidates and scheduled evidence enable controlled comparisons, but active questioning and open-ended diagnosis remain to be studied. Third, human review covers only a subset of the sufficiency boundary annotations t ∗ t^{*} . Model agreement and sampled audits support annotation quality, although individual boundaries may remain imprecise and warrant broader expert review.
blocks.zh: 首先,MedEVM是根据已公布的病例报告构建的,因此其疾病分布并不代表常规临床流行. 更广泛地对各种护理环境进行取样将加强外部有效性。 第二,固定候选人和预定证据能够进行有控制的比较,但积极的询问和开放式诊断仍有待研究。 第三,人文审查仅涵盖足够边界说明 t 的子集。 示范协定和抽样审计支持说明的质量,但个别界限可能仍然不准确,需要更广泛的专家审查。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our study of evidence–value misalignment in language models does not raise specific ethical concerns beyond data privacy. Although the benchmark draws on real clinical case reports, patient-identifying information had already been removed when these reports were published. We also checked for potentially identifying information during data screening to verify that the selected cases preserved patient privacy.
blocks.zh: 我们对于证据的研究—语言模型中的价值错位并没有引起超越数据隐私的特定伦理问题. 虽然基准参考了真实的临床病例报告,但在发表这些报告时,已经删除了识别病人的资料。 我们还检查了数据筛选过程中可能识别的信息,以核实所选病例是否保留了病人的隐私。

blocks.en: This appendix details the data sources, evidence and candidate construction, sufficiency annotation, and quality validation underlying MedEVM , as summarized in Section 3 . We complete all item filtering and annotation before evaluating the target models and make no subsequent revisions based on the reported evaluation results.
blocks.zh: 本附录详细介绍了第3节概述的数据来源、证据和候选构筑物、充分性说明以及MDEVM的质量验证。 在评价目标模型之前,我们先完成所有项目过滤和注释,然后不再根据所报告的评价结果进行修改。

blocks.en: A1.1 Case Collection and Structural Filtering
blocks.zh: A1.1 案件收集和结构过滤

blocks.en: We begin with a pool of 75,434 English-language medical case reports assembled from multiple sources. These include case collections used in existing medical benchmarks, such as DiagnosisArena ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , and journal reports acquired or crawled from PubMed-indexed sources ( White, 2020 ) . The source journals include NEJM, Cureus, BMJ Case Reports, Gastroenterology, JAMA, Neurology, The Lancet, Medicine, and Chest, among others. Every case in the final benchmark retains a case ID linking it to the original report pool and a journal-source label identifying its publication venue.
blocks.zh: 我们首先从多种来源收集了75 434份英文病例报告。 其中包括现有医疗基准中使用的病例收集,如DiagnosisArena(Zhu等人,2026年),以及从PubMed指数来源获取或爬行的期刊报告(White,2020年)。 来源期刊包括NEJM, Cureus, BMJ案例报告,胃肠病学,JAMA,神经学,The Lancet, Medicine,和胸骨等. 最终基准中的每个案例都保留一个案例ID,将其与原始报告集合联系起来,并保留一个日记来源标签,标明其出版地点。

blocks.en: Structural filtering proceeds in three steps. First, we normalize each narrative into four fields: case information, physical examination, diagnostic tests, and final diagnosis. This step yields 52,147 structured records. Second, we check basic completeness, requiring at least 300 characters of clinical history, a chief complaint or symptoms, non-empty diagnostic-test text, and a single normalized final diagnosis. Third, we assess whether the report contains sufficient evidence to support a progressive diagnostic sequence. Each report must include at least two laboratory, imaging, pathology, or special-test findings, with evidence available at all three stages of presentation, basic workup, and advanced confirmation. Across these checks, we exclude 6,378 reports with insufficient history, 8,130 with incomplete evidence stages, 1,437 with fewer than two tests, 94 without diagnostic-test text, and 88 without a chief complaint or symptoms. The remaining 36,020 reports proceed to evidence and option construction.
blocks.zh: 结构过滤分三步进行. 第一,我们把每个叙述都变成四个领域:病例信息、身体检查、诊断检查和最后诊断。 这一步骤产生了52,147项结构化记录。 第二,我们检查基本完整性,至少需要300个临床史字符,一个主要的投诉或症状,非空的诊断检测文本,以及一个单一的正常化的最终诊断. 第三,我们评估报告是否包含足够的证据来支持渐进的诊断序列。 每份报告必须至少包括两个实验室、成像、病理学或特别试验结果,在提交的所有三个阶段都有证据、基本工作和高级确认。 在这些检查中,我们排除了6 378份记录不足的报告、8 130份证据阶段不完整的报告、1 437份不到两次的测试、94份没有诊断测试文本的报告、88份没有主要投诉或症状的报告。 其余的36 020份报告继续进行证据和备选方案建设。

blocks.en: A1.2 Evidence and Option Construction
blocks.zh: A1.2 证据和备选建筑

blocks.en: For each qualified report, we retain information available before diagnosis and remove explicit diagnosis names, treatment outcomes, and follow-up information. We then segment the remaining narrative into minimal, self-contained units of clinical evidence. Each evidence item retains an anchor to the original text, its source section, its clinical stage, and an evidence-type label. These labels cover demographics, chief complaint, history, symptoms, medication, vital signs, physical examination, laboratory tests, imaging, pathology, procedures, and special tests. We arrange the evidence items in the order of clinical disclosure in the source report. This preserves a traceable progression of available information and prevents model-generated reordering intended solely to increase task difficulty.
blocks.zh: 对于每一份有保留意见的报告,我们保留在诊断前可获得的信息,并删除明确的诊断名称、治疗结果和后续信息。 然后我们把剩下的叙事 分成最小的自成一体的临床证据单元 每件证据项保留了原文本的锚,其来源部分,临床阶段,以及证据类标签. 这些标签包括人口统计、主要投诉、历史、症状、药物、生命迹象、身体检查、实验室测试、成像、病理、程序和特殊测试。 我们安排证据项目 顺序在临床披露 在来源报告。 这保留了可用信息的可追踪进展,防止了模式生成的重排,目的只是为了增加任务难度。

blocks.en: We convert each case into a ten-way diagnostic question comprising the confirmed diagnosis and nine clinically plausible confounders. GPT-5.4 first proposes 10–15 differential diagnoses, from which it selects nine based on clinical similarity and whether the complete case evidence can rule them out. For each confounder, the model must identify at least three shared symptoms or signs that make it plausible early in the case, specific evidence from the report that supports it, and a test or finding that ultimately excludes it. We discard candidates that are synonymous with the gold diagnosis, differ only in diagnostic granularity, lack support in the case, or cannot be ruled out by the available evidence. We remove explicit diagnostic wording from the question stem and randomize the position of the correct answer.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个病例 变成一个十进制的诊断问题 包括确认的诊断 和9个临床上 可信的困惑者。 GPT-5.4首先提出10–15个差分诊断,从中根据临床相似性选择9个,以及完整的案例证据能否排除. 对于每一个困惑者,模型必须至少确定三种共同的症状或征兆,使案件在早期是可信的,报告的具体证据支持它,以及最终排除它的测试或发现. 我们抛弃了与金诊断同义的候选者,仅在诊断颗粒性上存在差异,在病例中缺乏支持,或者无法被现有证据排除. 我们从问题中去掉明确的诊断措辞,随意确定正确答案的立场。

blocks.en: We next screen the constructed questions for answer uniqueness and difficulty. The complete evidence must support exactly one candidate, so we exclude items with compound diagnoses, multiple defensible answers, diagnostic leakage, or inconsistent option granularity. Multiple strong models then solve each question independently. Items that can be answered consistently from superficial cues without integrating the clinical evidence are excluded as too easy. This stage retains 7,472 usable multiple-choice questions for sufficiency-boundary annotation and quality validation.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们来筛选所构建的问题,以回答独有性和困难。 完整的证据必须支持一个候选人,所以我们排除了具有复合诊断,多重可辨解答案,诊断渗漏,或者选择颗粒性不一致的物品. 多个强模型然后独立解决每个问题. 没有综合临床证据就能从表面角度一致回答的项目被排除为太容易。 这一阶段保留了7,472个可用的多选择问题,用于充分边界说明和质量验证。

blocks.en: A1.3 Sufficiency Boundary and Quality Validation
blocks.zh: A1.3 充分边界和质量验证

blocks.en: The boundary-annotation prompt contains the ten diagnostic candidates and the ordered sequence of atomic evidence. Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and GPT-5.6-sol independently identify the earliest position at which the accumulated evidence uniquely distinguishes the correct diagnosis from all competing candidates. We retain only cases for which all three annotators identify exactly the same position and assign this position as t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} . This procedure operationalizes the sufficiency criterion in Section 3 , providing a case-level reference independent of the evaluated model.
blocks.zh: 边界-注释提示符包含十个诊断对象和命令的原子证据序列. Claude Opus 4.8,双子座3.1 Pro Preview,和GPT-5.6-sol独立确定最早的位置,在这种位置上,所积累的证据将正确的诊断与所有竞争对手区分开来. 我们只保留所有三位注释员都确定完全相同职位并将此职位指定为t i * t_{i}^{*} 的案件。 这一程序使第3节的充足性标准投入运作,提供了独立于评价模型的个案参考。

blocks.en: Automated quality control then reviews the source case, candidate set, and proposed boundary in a fixed sequence. We first recheck the source report for sufficient clinical detail, internal consistency, and a definitive diagnosis, removing cases with unresolved deficiencies. We next verify that the complete evidence supports a unique answer and exclude any remaining low-difficulty items that do not require evidence integration. Finally, Gemini 3.5 Flash independently validates the proposed boundary against the candidates and ordered evidence sequence. We obtain three independent judgments per item and retain it only if all three confirm that t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} is the earliest sufficient position. Gemini 3.5 Flash serves as a separate validator and does not contribute to the preceding three-model boundary agreement.

To assess the quality of the automated annotations, five graduate researchers with medical backgrounds independently review 200 randomly sampled items. They evaluate the coherence of each case, the uniqueness of its correct answer, the clinical plausibility of its confounders, and whether t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} marks the earliest sufficient boundary. Item-level inter-rater agreement reaches 92.5%, and majority voting rates 94.0% of the sampled items as accurately annotated. Across cases, the mean within-item standard deviation of the human boundary annotations is 0.84 turns, showing modest dispersion in the judged position across reviewers. We examine sensitivity to one- and two-turn tolerance windows in Appendix A3.2 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估自动说明的质量,五名具有医学背景的研究生独立审查200个随机抽样的项目. 他们评价了每个病例的一致性,正确答案的独特性,其开结者的临床可信度,以及t i * t_{i}^{*}}^{*} 是否标志着最早的足够边界. 标的级间协议达到92.5%,多数票率94.0%的抽样项目有准确的说明. 在各种情况中,人类边界说明在项目内的平均标准偏差为0.84转弯,显示审查者在判断位置上略有分散。 我们审查附录A3.2中对一转和二转容窗的敏感性。

blocks.en: Quality control yields 1,810 valid dynamic-diagnosis items. From this pool, we select 1,050 cases through stratified sampling by disease system and empirical difficulty to form the final MedEVM benchmark. The release covers 953 distinct diagnoses across 24 disease systems and contains 26,869 atomic evidence items. Each case includes ten diagnostic candidates and an average of 25.6 evidence items, and the mean position of the sufficiency boundary t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} is 21.3.
blocks.zh: 质量控制出产1,810个有效的动态诊断项目. 从这个集合中,我们通过按疾病系统分类的抽样和经验困难来选择1 050个病例,形成最终的MedEVM基准. 发布内容涵盖24个疾病系统的953个不同诊断,包含26,869个原子证据项目. 每起案件包括10个诊断候选人和平均25.6个证据项目,充足边界t i * t_{i}^{*}的平均值为21.3。

Diagnosis outcome disagreement is the indicator that two trajectories submit different diagnoses or that only one submits a diagnosis. Two non-answers count as agreement. blocks.en: Appendix A3 Experimental Details and Additional Mechanism Analyses

blocks.en: A3.1 Shared Interaction and Probability Measurement
blocks.zh: A3.1 共同相互作用和概率衡量

blocks.en: The four mechanism experiments in Section 4 share a sequential diagnosis protocol. The model receives ten candidate diagnoses, followed by one evidence item per turn. Each request includes the initial instructions, candidates, accumulated evidence, and previous JSON actions. It returns {"action":"wait","answer":""} to receive more evidence or {"action":"answer","answer":"<option letter>"} to submit a diagnosis. The first submission ends the trajectory. Waiting after the final evidence item produces a non-answer. Accuracy, submission rate, and timing categories follow Appendix A2.1 .
blocks.zh: 第4节中的四项机制实验共用了顺序诊断协议. 该模型得到10项候选人诊断,然后是每轮1项证据。 每项请求包括初步指示、候选人、累积证据以及JSON以前的行动。 它返回 {"动作":"等待","回答":"}得到更多的证据或{动作':"回答","回答":"<可选字母>>}提交诊断. 第一次提交结束轨迹。 在最后证据项之后等待会产生一个不回答。 准确性、提交率和时间类别见附录A2.1。

blocks.en: Figure A1 reproduces the system prompt used with thinking disabled and the templates for the case-opening and evidence messages. The model is instructed to answer once the available evidence supports a reliable choice. Neither the ground-truth diagnosis nor t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} is included in its input.
blocks.zh: 图A1复制了用于思维失效的提示系统以及打开案件和证据信息的模板。 一旦现有证据支持可靠的选择,即指示该模型作出答复。 其投入中既未包括地面真实诊断,也未包括i t i}^{*}。

blocks.en: Figure A1: Diagnosis interaction prompt. The system prompt is reproduced verbatim, with line wrapping adjusted for readability. Bracketed fields in the message templates are filled from the case record, and the complete candidate list is provided at the start.
blocks.zh: 图A1:诊断互动即时. 系统提示是逐字复制的,按可读性调整行包。 消息模板中的括号字段从案例记录中填充,并在开始时提供完整的候选名单.

blocks.en: The paired interventions retain the source case, candidate diagnosis texts, correct diagnosis, and generation settings. RQ3 changes evidence order, while RQ4 inserts repeated, irrelevant, or misleading evidence. A supplementary control changes candidate labels. Each design below specifies whether it evaluates a natural trajectory or a reconstructed evidence prefix.
blocks.zh: 配对干预措施保留了源病例、候选诊断文本、正确的诊断和生成环境。 RQ3改变证据顺序,而RQ4则插入重复,无关,或误导性的证据. 补充控制改变候选标签。 下面的每一个设计都具体说明它评价的是自然轨迹还是重建的证据前缀.

blocks.en: At each measured turn, we copy the current conversation containing the candidate list, all evidence received so far, and the preceding actions. In this cloned context, we fix the scoring prefix and evaluate candidate continuations. The same procedure applies at diagnosis-submission and waiting turns. Neither the scoring prefix nor its continuations are added to the ongoing conversation. The original action therefore determines whether the diagnostic trajectory ends or receives further evidence.
blocks.zh: 在每一个有分量的转弯时,我们都会复制目前包含候选人名单、迄今收到的所有证据以及前述行动的对话。 在这种克隆背景下,我们固定评分前缀并评价候选续作. 同样的程序适用于诊断提交和等待轮班。 评分前缀及其续作均不加入进行中的对话. 因此,最初的动作决定诊断轨迹是结束还是收到进一步的证据.

blocks.en: Candidate scoring uses the fixed diagnosis prefix {"action":"answer","answer":" in all conditions. At this position, we score all ten candidate labels as alternative continuations of the same context and normalize them using Equation A3 . For a multi-token label, its log-probability sums the conditional log-probabilities of its tokens. With thinking enabled, the scoring context also contains the reasoning generated before the JSON response.
blocks.zh: 考生评分在所有条件下使用固定的诊断前缀{"动作":"回答","回答":". 在这个位置上,我们把所有十个候选标签评为同一上下文的替代延续,并使用方程式A3实现它们正常化。 对于多键标签,其日志概率等于其符号的有条件的日志概率. 随着思维的启用,评分上下文也包含了JSON响应之前产生的推理.

blocks.en: Action scoring uses the shorter prefix {"action":" . We score the complete continuations wait and answer and normalize over the two actions as in Equation A3 . The resulting p ⁡ ( answer ) p(\mathrm{answer}) measures submission propensity, while the candidate distribution measures diagnostic belief over the ten diagnoses at the same evidence prefix.
blocks.zh: 动作积分使用较短的前缀{"动作":". 我们像在方程式A3中那样,在两个行动上等待和回答并正常化。 由此产生的p QQ( 回答) p(\ mathrm{ answer}) 测量提交倾向, 而候选人分布则测量诊断信念, 相对于10个诊断, 在同一证据前缀。

blocks.en: Each model is evaluated on the same 1,050 cases. Paired confidence intervals use the case-bootstrap procedure in Appendix A2.4 . Natural measurements end at the first diagnosis submission, so later-turn summaries identify which trajectories remain available.
blocks.zh: 对每个模型都进行了同样的1 050个案例的评估。 信任间隔使用附录A2.4中的个案记录程序。 自然测量在第一次提交诊断材料时结束,所以后轮总结确定哪些轨迹仍然可用.

blocks.en: A3.2 Diagnosis Submission Timing and Belief at the Sufficiency Boundary
blocks.zh: A3.2 充分边界的诊断提交时间和信仰

blocks.en: In RQ1 , each case follows its original evidence order. Figure 3 reports the four submission-timing categories defined in Appendix A2.1 , separately from diagnostic correctness.
blocks.zh: 在RQ1中,每个案件都遵循其原始证据命令。 图3报告附录A2.1中界定的四种提交方式的类别,与诊断正确性分开。

blocks.en: In RQ2 , we measure candidate probabilities at each evidence checkpoint and summarize p gold p_{\mathrm{gold}} at submission and at t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} . The submission summary includes answered trajectories. The boundary summary includes trajectories that reach t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} , whether they answer or wait at that turn. Figure 4 therefore compares belief at actual submission with belief upon receiving sufficient evidence, using the cases available at each point, which may differ because early submissions end before sufficient evidence arrives.
blocks.zh: 在RQ2中,我们在每个证据检查点衡量候选人的概率,并在提交和t i t i i i 时总结 p gold p _{\mathrm{gold}}。 划界案摘要包括已答复的轨迹。 边界摘要包括到达 t i * t_{i}^{*}的轨迹,无论是在那个转弯时回答还是等待. 因此,图4利用每一点的现有案例,将实际提交时的信念与收到充分证据时的信念加以比较,这种比较可能有所不同,因为及早提交证据在充分证据到达之前就已经结束。

blocks.en: The human review reports a mean within-case standard deviation of 0.84 turns for boundary judgments (Appendix A1 ). We therefore examine whether the RQ1 patterns depend on an exact turn match. Keeping each annotated t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} as the reference, we rescore the existing trajectories with tolerance k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 2 } k\in\{0,1,2\} . A submission is premature if τ i < t i ∗ − k \tau_{i}<t_{i}^{*}-k , aligned if | τ i − t i ∗ | ≤ k |\tau_{i}-t_{i}^{*}|\leq k , and delayed if τ i > t i ∗ + k \tau_{i}>t_{i}^{*}+k . Unanswered cases remain a separate category. This changes the timing score without changing the evidence, model responses, or diagnostic correctness. The window accommodates uncertainty in the annotation rather than asserting that evidence before t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} is sufficient.
Table A1: RQ1 timing sensitivity to a tolerance of k k turns around the annotated boundary. All rates use the same 1,050 cases per model. Non-answer rates are unchanged and omitted.
blocks.zh: 表 A1: RQ1 对 k 的容忍度的灵敏度 。 所有费率都采用同样的每个模式的1 050个病例。 非回答率不变,省略.

blocks.en: Allowing one turn increases the aligned fraction by 1.6–13.4 percentage points across models, and allowing two turns increases it by 3.3–21.0 points (Table A1 ). These increases reflect the more permissive scoring rule. They do not remove the main behavioral differences: Qwen3-8B still submits prematurely in 96.0% of cases at k = 2 k=2 , while DeepSeek and the Kimi models retain non-answer rates of 30.9–37.4%. The tolerance reduces both premature and delayed classifications, but substantial timing mismatch or non-response remains for every model. We retain k = 0 k=0 for the other reported experiments so that their evidence checkpoints and intervention positions share the same annotated reference.
blocks.zh: 允许一个转弯使各模型的对齐分数增加1.6-13.4个百分点,允许两个转弯使其增加3.3-21.0个百分点(表A1)。 这些增加反映了比较宽容的评分规则。 它们不会消除主要的行为差异: Qune3-8B在96.0%的病例中仍以k=2k=2的方式过早提交,而DeepSeek和Kimi模型保留了30.9–37.4%的不回答率. 容忍度减少了过早和延迟的分类,但每个模型都仍然存在着时间不匹配或无反应的情况。 我们保留k=0k=0用于其他已报告的试验,以便他们的取证检查站和干预阵地有同样的附加说明的参考。

blocks.en: Applying the same tolerance to the thinking trajectories yields premature-submission rates of 90.8–99.1% at k = 1 k=1 and 85.5–98.4% at k = 2 k=2 . Each remains above the corresponding non-thinking rate. Thus, the increase in premature submission with thinking is not explained solely by decisions one or two turns away from the annotated boundary.
blocks.zh: 对思维轨迹采用同样的耐受性,过早提交率为90.8-99.1%,按k=1k=1,按k=2k=2计算,为85.5-98.4%。 每个都高于相应的非思考率。 因此,不只因为一两项决定偏离了附加说明的边界,就增加了不成熟的屈服。

blocks.en: A3.3 Thinking-Mode Evaluation and Belief Measurement
blocks.zh: A3.3 思维模式评价和信仰衡量

blocks.en: The thinking comparison supplements RQ1 and RQ2 for seven models: four Qwen3 sizes, Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, and DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Both modes use the same cases, candidates, evidence, temperature, and seed. With thinking enabled, the prompt permits internal reasoning but still requires a final action JSON and follows the same stopping rule.
blocks.zh: 思考比较为7种型号补充了RQ1和RQ2:4种Qune3大小,Qune3.6-27B,Qune3.8-27B,以及DeepSeek-V4-Flash. 两种模式都使用相同的案例,候选,证据,温度,种子. 在思维允许的情况下,即时允许内部推理,但仍需要最后行动JSON并遵循同样的停止规则。

blocks.en: In both modes, candidate probabilities are scored after {"action":"answer","answer":" in the cloned context. With thinking enabled, the generated reasoning precedes this fixed prefix. An illustrative continuation is <think>[reasoning]</think> {"action":"answer","answer":"C"} At the position occupied by C, we score all candidate labels A–J and normalize over those labels. The distribution is conditioned on the cloned conversation, the generated reasoning, and the fixed JSON prefix. With thinking disabled, the same procedure scores the labels without a preceding reasoning segment.
blocks.zh: 在两种模式中,候选概率都是在{"动作":"回答","回答"后在克隆语境中得分. 随着思维的启用,生成的推理在此固定前缀之前. 一个说明性的续作是 < Think>[合理性] </think > {“行动”:“回答”,“回答”:“C ” 。 在C担任的职位上,我们给所有候选人打上A-J的标签,并将这些标签正常化。 发行以克隆对话,生成推理,以及固定的JSON前缀为条件. 由于思维障碍,同一程序对标签的评分没有先前的推理部分。

blocks.en: A natural wait response need not contain an answer field. To measure diagnostic belief at that turn, we supply the same fixed answer-field prefix in the cloned context and score all ten candidate labels. This procedure also applies to thinking-enabled waiting turns, where the generated reasoning precedes the scoring prefix. It does not introduce a new instruction asking the model to select a diagnosis. The original wait action remains unchanged, so the diagnostic trajectory continues to receive evidence.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的等待反应不需要包含一个答案字段. 为了在那个转弯时测量诊断信念,我们在克隆语境中提供相同的固定的答案字段前缀,并得分所有十个候选标签. 这个程序也适用于思维辅助的等待转弯,其中生成的推理先于积分前缀. 它没有引入要求模型选择诊断的新指令. 最初的等待动作保持不变,因此诊断轨迹继续获得证据.

blocks.en: All measurements use token probabilities for the candidate alternatives rather than a numerical confidence statement generated by the model. For illustration, if label C has probability mass 0.24 and the ten labels together have mass 0.60, its normalized probability is p ⁡ ( C ) = 0.40 p(C)=0.40 . Submission and waiting checkpoints use the same scoring prefix. With thinking enabled, gold belief and ECE describe predictions conditioned on the generated reasoning.
blocks.zh: 所有测量都使用候选替代品的象征性概率,而不是模型产生的数字信任度说明。 举例来说,如果标签C的概率质量为0.24,而10个标签加在一起的质量为0.60,则其正常概率为p Q(C)=0.40 p(C)=0.40。 提交和等待检查点使用相同的评分前缀。 有了思维能力,黄金信念和欧洲经委会描述的预测以产生的推理为条件。

blocks.en: Table A2 uses the metrics in Appendix A2.2 . Early submission includes all completed trajectories, submission accuracy includes answered trajectories, and p gold p_{\mathrm{gold}} is measured at the diagnosis field during submission. Margin and ECE pool all measured evidence checkpoints. Only 3–51 cases per model reach t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} with thinking enabled, after early submissions have ended the other trajectories.
blocks.zh: 表A2采用附录A2.2中的衡量尺度。 早期提交包括所有已完成的轨迹,提交精度包括解答的轨迹,p金 p_{\mathrm{gold}}在提交期间在诊断场测量. 边际和欧洲经委会汇集了所有衡量证据检查站。 每个模型只有3-51个案例到达t i * t i}^{*},在早期提交文件结束其他轨迹后,有了思维能力。

blocks.en: Table A2: Thinking-mode results. All rates, probabilities, margins, and ECE are multiplied by 100. Off/on denotes the thinking setting. p gold p_{\mathrm{gold}} is measured at diagnosis submission, whereas margin and ECE use all measured evidence checkpoints. n t ∗ n_{t^{*}} counts boundary measurements with thinking on.
blocks.zh: 表A2:思维模式结果。 所有费率、概率、幅度和欧洲经委会乘以100。 关闭/关闭表示思维环境。 p golden p_{\mathrm{gold}}}在诊断提交时加以衡量,而边距和欧洲经委会则使用所有测量的证据检查站。 n t * n_{t^{*}} 以思考来计算边界测量.

blocks.en: Thinking raises premature submission to 94.1–99.7% across the seven models. Qwen3-8B already submits prematurely on 99.1% of cases with thinking off, and its submission accuracy rises slightly from 10.9% to 11.3%. Accuracy falls for the other six models. DeepSeek-V4-Flash, for example, moves from 24.6% to 97.3% premature submission while accuracy falls from 70.5% to 28.5%. All seven models show lower submission-point gold belief and higher ECE. The large probability margins in the Qwen variants therefore reflect confident preferences that are often incorrect.
blocks.zh: 思考使七个模型的过早提交率达到94.1-99.7%。 Qune3-8B已经提前提交了99.1%的有思考的病例,其提交准确度从10.9%略升至11.3%。 准确性属于其他六个模型. 例如,DeepSeek-V4-Flash从24.6%提前提交到97.3%,而准确性则从70.5%下降到28.5%。 所有7个模型都显示提交点金色信念较低,欧洲经委会则更高。 因此,Quen变体中的大概率差反映了常常不正确的自信偏好.

blocks.en: A3.4 Evidence Order: Comparing Final Diagnoses and Boundary Beliefs
blocks.zh: A3.4 证据令:比较最后诊断和边界信仰

blocks.en: RQ3 retains each original sequence and constructs up to four distinct permutations of the evidence before t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} . Using a fixed seed, we first shuffle within clinical stages and then shuffle the full prefix if needed to obtain additional distinct orders. The evidence at t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} and afterward remains fixed. Trajectories reaching the boundary have therefore received identical evidence sets in different orders.
blocks.zh: RQ3保留了每个原始序列,在t i * t_{i}^{*} 之前构造最多四个不同的证据形态. 使用固定的种子,我们首先在临床阶段进行洗涤,然后在需要时进行洗涤,以获得额外的明显订单. 在t i 和t i i 之后的证据保持不变。 因此,到达边界的轨迹收到了不同命令的相同证据。

blocks.en: We compare final diagnosis outcomes for every original–permuted pair, including early-terminated trajectories. We separately compare pairs with candidate probabilities available in both orders at t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} , using each trajectory’s own accumulated conversation. For these pairs, we compute boundary JSD and eventual diagnosis disagreement on the same cases. Both metrics follow the aggregation in Appendix A2.3 , so a case with more eligible permutations receives no additional weight.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了每对原始的诊断结果,包括早期终止的轨迹。 我们利用每个轨迹本身的累积对话, 对于这些对子,我们计算边界 JSD 和最终的诊断 对同一病例的分歧。 两种衡量标准都遵循附录A2.3中的汇总,因此,一个具有更多合格排列的个案没有额外权重。

blocks.en: Reordering changes 29.0–52.9% of final outcomes across the full cohort. Among pairs reaching the boundary, models other than Qwen3-8B have mean JSD values of 0.0090–0.0436 but still disagree on 6.2–20.6% of final outcomes (Table A3 ). Similar beliefs after the same evidence thus coexist with different eventual diagnoses. Qwen3-8B contributes only seven boundary-observed source cases because it usually submits earlier, producing a wide confidence interval.
blocks.zh: 整组人最终结果的29.0-52.9%的调整。 在到达边界的对子中,Qwen3-8B以外的模型的JSD值为0.0090-0.0436,但对于最终结果的6.2-20.6%仍有分歧(表A3)。 因此,在同样证据之后的类似信念与不同的最终诊断并存。 Qune3-8B只贡献了7个边界观测源案例,因为它通常提前提交,产生了宽广的置信间隔.

blocks.en: Table A3: Evidence-order comparisons for pairs in which both trajectories reach t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} . Source cases and order pairs count distinct cases and eligible original–permuted comparisons, respectively. JSD and final diagnosis disagreement use the same pairs and equal source-case weights. Brackets give 95% bootstrap confidence intervals. All order pairs from a sampled case remain together.
blocks.zh: 表A3:两种轨迹都达到 t i * t_{i}^{*}的对称证据顺序比较. 来源案例和顺序对数分别算出不同案例和符合条件的原生比较。 JSD和最终诊断的分歧使用相同的对和平等的源病例权重. Brackets给95%的靴子置信间隔. 样本中的所有定单对都保持在一起。

blocks.en: A3.5 Repeated Evidence, Irrelevant Text, and Candidate Labels
blocks.zh: A3.5 重复的证据、无关文本和候选人标签

blocks.en: The first evidence-value intervention in RQ4 tests whether text without new diagnostic information changes the model’s response. We select prefixes ending at approximately 25%, 50%, and 75% of the evidence sequence, at t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} , and one turn before the original natural diagnosis submission when available. Prefixes contain at least one item, and coincident positions are merged. At each position, two branches share the same evidence prefix. One repeats its first, middle, or most recent evidence item. The other adds a clinically irrelevant statement, such as “The weather is sunny today.” Neither supplies a new clinical fact that helps distinguish among the candidate diagnoses.
blocks.zh: RQ4中的第一个证据价值干预测试没有新诊断信息的文本是否改变模型的反应. 我们选择前缀, 以大约25%、50%和75%的 证据序列结束, 在 t i , t i i i , 当有原始的 自然诊断 提交 之前, 一个回合。 前缀中至少包含一个项目,而同时位置被合并. 在每个位置上,两个分支共用相同的证据前缀. 一个重复它的第一,中间,或最近的证据项目. 另一个补充了一个临床上无关紧要的说法,如“今天天气晴朗”。 两者都无法提供有助于区分候选人诊断的新临床事实。

blocks.en: To measure the response at each selected position, we reconstruct the prefix in a separate conversation, recording wait after each preceding evidence item. We then append the repeated evidence or irrelevant statement and let the model choose its next action. We measure beliefs before and after the addition and compare the diagnosis outputs of the two branches immediately afterward. A difference occurs if the model submits different diagnoses or submits a diagnosis in one branch while waiting in the other. These are local responses to the inserted text at a common evidence prefix.
blocks.zh: 为了测量每个选定位置的反应,我们在单独的谈话中重建前缀,记录在之前的每一个证据项之后等待. 然后我们附上重复的证据或无关的陈述,让模型选择下一步行动。 我们衡量添加前后的信仰,并比较之后两个分支的诊断结果。 如果模型在一个分支中提交不同的诊断,或者在另一个分支中提交诊断,则会出现差异. 这些是当地对在共同证据前缀插入的文本的答复。

blocks.en: Figure A2: Diagnosis output differences immediately after repeated evidence or irrelevant text is added to the same evidence prefix. Points show the percentage of comparisons with different submitted diagnoses or a diagnosis in only one branch. Intervals are source-case bootstrap 95% confidence intervals, with comparisons averaged within each case.
blocks.zh: 图A2:重复证据或无关文本后立即将诊断输出差异加入同一证据前缀. 点数显示仅在一个分支与不同提交的诊断或诊断进行比较的百分比。 间隔是95%的置信间隔,在每种情况下进行比较。

blocks.en: Diagnosis outputs differ in 5.5–34.4% of comparisons (Figure A2 ), with the largest effect in Qwen3-8B. Although neither addition supplies new diagnostic information, the choice of text changes whether the model submits a diagnosis and which diagnosis it submits.
blocks.zh: 诊断结果在5.5–34.4%的比较(图A2)中有所不同,在Qune3-8B中效果最大. 虽然两者都不提供新的诊断信息,但文本的选择会改变模型是否提交诊断以及它提交的诊断。

blocks.en: A separate control tests candidate-label sensitivity. For each case, four fixed-seed permutations reassign the ten letters to the existing diagnosis rows while preserving diagnosis text, row order, and evidence. For example, a diagnosis originally labeled A may receive F in the same row. We run each version naturally and map submitted labels back to diagnoses before comparison. Final outcomes differ from the original-label run in 9.7–28.8% of cases, including diagnosis-versus-non-answer differences. The identifiers alone can therefore influence the final outcome.
blocks.zh: 单独的控制测试候选标签敏感性. 每例4个固定种子排位将这10个字母重新分配给现有的诊断行,同时保留诊断文本,排位顺序和证据. 例如,原标注为A的诊断可能在同一行中接收F. 我们自然地运行每个版本,在比较之前将标签提交诊断。 最终结果与9.7%至28.8%的病例的原始标签不同,包括诊断与非答案差异。 因此,只有识别资料才能影响最终结果。

blocks.en: A3.6 Misleading Evidence: Construction, Measurements, and Results
blocks.zh: A3.6 误导 证据:构建、计量和结果

blocks.en: The strength intervention in RQ4 examines how evidence favoring an incorrect diagnosis changes beliefs and subsequent submissions. We first synthesize misleading evidence for the 1,050 cases in MedEVM . For each case, an incorrect candidate serves as the target diagnosis. We construct weak and strong observations that favor this target while matching their clinical event type, semantic direction, and presentation format. Each version is inserted early in the sequence, immediately before the original sufficient-evidence item, or immediately after it. The source case, target, and insertion position remain fixed within a strong–weak pair.
blocks.zh: 对RQ4的强度干预考察了赞成错误诊断的证据如何改变信仰和随后的提交. 我们首先综合了对MedEVM1 050个案件的误导性证据。 对于每个病例,一个不正确的候选人作为目标诊断. 我们构建了有利于这个目标的弱和强的观测,同时匹配他们的临床事件类型,语义方向和呈现格式. 每个版本都是在序列的早期插入的,紧接在原始的充分证据项之前,或者紧接其后. 源文件箱、目标和插入位置仍固定在一个强弱对中。

blocks.en: Before forming the test set, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, and GPT-5.6-sol independently review the augmented evidence sequences. The reviewers judge whether the original decisive evidence still marks the earliest point at which the correct diagnosis can be distinguished from the candidates. When insertion precedes that item, its turn index shifts forward by one. All three reviewers agree that the boundary remains valid for 553 cases, from which we manually select 318 for the intervention experiment. The construction review also checks that inserted findings are clinically coherent, temporally possible, and free of information from later evidence.
blocks.zh: 在形成测试集之前,克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus) 4.8,双子座3.1 Pro Preview,以及GPT-5.6-sol独立检视增强的证据序列. 审查者判断原始的决定性证据是否仍然标志着可以将正确的诊断与候选人区分开的最早点. 在该项目之前插入时,其转动指数将向前移动一个。 所有三位审查者都同意,边界对553个案例依然有效,我们从中手动选择了318个用于干预实验. 施工审查还检查了所插入的调查结果是否在临床上一致,在时间上是可能的,并且没有以后证据的信息。

blocks.en: The following two high-strength examples show the complete evidence available through the original sufficient-evidence item, together with the inserted distractor. Both distractors support a competing diagnosis without replacing the source-report evidence that identifies the correct diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 以下两个高强度的例子显示了通过原始的充分证据项目可以获得的完整证据,以及插入的分散器. 这两种分散注意力者都支持相互竞争的诊断,而不是取代能够识别正确诊断的源报告证据.

blocks.en: In the first case, hearing loss, tympanic changes, and the inserted flat tympanogram make middle-ear effusion plausible before evidence E9. The histopathologic finding of branched fungal hyphae is the first observation that identifies the fungus ball among the candidates. The insertion therefore changes the turn number of that finding from 9 to 10 without changing the correct diagnosis or the decisive evidence. In the second case, cervical inflammation may coexist with the presenting symptoms, but it arrives after the hysterosalpingogram has shown contrast entering the bowel. It does not explain that finding or move the earliest sufficient turn away from evidence E15.

blocks.en: For each intervention version, we construct separate conversations containing the candidate list and accumulated evidence up to four positions: immediately before insertion, immediately after insertion, upon receipt of the original sufficient-evidence item, and at the end of the complete sequence. These measurement conversations contain no intervening diagnosis actions. This allows us to examine all four evidence positions for every intervention version, even when a natural trajectory would answer earlier. For insertion after the boundary, the boundary measurement precedes insertion. The positions are evaluated in their actual sequence order, preserving the clinical history available at each measurement.
blocks.zh: 对于每个干预版本,我们分别构建包含候选人名单和累积证据的谈话,最多可达四个位置:紧接插入前,紧接插入后,收到原始的充分证据项目后,以及完整序列结束时. 这些测量对话没有包含干预性诊断行动。 这使我们能够审查每个干预版本的所有四个证据位置,即使一个自然轨迹会早一些回答。 为了在边界之后插入,边界测量在插入之前。 这些位置按其实际序列顺序进行评估,保留每次测量时可用的临床史.

blocks.en: At each position, we record p target p_{\mathrm{target}} , p gold p_{\mathrm{gold}} , their difference, and the highest-probability candidate, together with submission propensity p ⁡ ( answer ) p(\mathrm{answer}) . The belief metrics and strong-minus-weak contrasts are defined in Appendix A2.3 . Measurements immediately before and after insertion quantify the initial response, while the final prefix measures the effect remaining after all original evidence has arrived, including the evidence that establishes the correct diagnosis.
blocks.zh: 在每一个位置,我们记录p目标p_{\mathrm{目标}},pgold p_{\mathrm{黄金}},它们的区别,以及最高概率的候选人,以及提交p⁡(答复)p(\mathrm{答复}). 信仰度量和强弱对比的定义载于附录A2.3。 插入前和插入后立即测量,量化初始反应,而最后前缀测量所有原始证据,包括证明正确诊断的证据到达后仍然存在的效果.

blocks.en: Each strong and weak version also runs as a separate natural trajectory, with the model free to wait or submit after each item. The first submission ends the interaction. We record target submissions, submission timing, correctness, and non-answers. These outcomes link the measured belief shifts to actual diagnosis submissions, including failures to submit after the complete evidence sequence has been revealed.
blocks.zh: 每个强弱版本也作为单独的自然轨迹运行,模型可以在每个项目后自由等待或提交. 第一次提交结束交互。 我们记录提交目标、提交时间、正确性和不回答。 这些结果将衡量的信念转变与实际的诊断材料联系起来,包括在完整证据序列被揭示后未能提交。

blocks.en: All five effects are positive in every model, with confidence intervals excluding zero. Stronger evidence adds 11.1–24.6 points to the immediate increase in target belief. For models other than Qwen3-8B, target submission rises by 21.7–35.0 points and diagnostic accuracy falls by 7.2–26.7 points. blocks.en: This appendix separates the prediction of diagnosis submission from the assessment of errors at submission, then details the Natural Gate intervention in Section 5 . It also examines diagnostic beliefs after prematurely stopped cases receive sufficient evidence. Metric definitions appear in Appendix A2 .

blocks.en: A4.1 Separating Submission Prediction from Error Assessment
blocks.zh: A4.1 将提交材料与错误评估分开

blocks.en: We use the existing non-thinking trajectories and probability measurements for all nine LLMs from Sections 3 and 4 . No additional diagnostic trajectories are generated. The first task asks whether a model that currently waits will submit a diagnosis on the next turn. The second asks whether a diagnosis is incorrect when the model submits it. Separating these targets allows us to test whether EVM features carry information about diagnostic correctness in addition to their ability to predict submission behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们使用现有的非思维轨迹 和概率测量 来自第3和第4节的所有9个LLM。 没有产生额外的诊断轨迹. 第一个任务询问目前等待的模型是否会在下一个回合提交诊断. 第二个问题是,当模型提交诊断时,诊断是否不正确。 分离这些目标可以让我们测试EVM特征除了能预测提交行为外,是否还包含关于诊断正确性的信息.

blocks.en: For next-turn submission prediction, an eligible example is a checkpoint at which the model chooses wait and a subsequent turn is observed. Inputs are measured through the current turn t t , and the label is one when the action at t + 1 t+1 is answer , regardless of which diagnosis is submitted. A further wait gives label zero. For example, waiting at turn 8 and submitting at turn 9 produces a positive example at turn 8, whether the diagnosis is correct or incorrect. Before balancing, this support contains 163,551 checkpoints and 7,941 positive examples. The submission frequency varies from 3.1% to 20.0% across LLMs, motivating the class-balanced comparison below.
blocks.zh: 对于下一个回合的提交预测,一个符合条件的例子是一个检查点,模型在检查点中选择等待,然后观察一个转弯. 输入通过当前转动 t t 进行测量,当 t + 1 t+1 的动作是回答时,无论提交哪个诊断,标签都是一个. 进一步等待会给出标签0. 例如,第8轮等待和第9轮提交在第8轮产生一个积极的例子,无论诊断是否正确。 在平衡之前,这一支助包括163 551个检查站和7 941个积极的例子。 提交频率从3.1%到20.0%不等,刺激了下文的类平衡比较。

blocks.en: For error assessment at submission, each trajectory contributes its first diagnosis submission, yielding 7,942 examples before balancing. Inputs are measured at that submission turn, and the label is one if the submitted diagnosis differs from the ground truth. Correct submissions have label zero. Cases without a submitted diagnosis do not enter this task. Thus, this experiment evaluates the ability to distinguish incorrect from correct submissions using the state at submission. The preceding experiment separately measures prediction of future behavior from a waiting checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 对于提交时的错误评估,每个轨迹都有助于首次提交诊断材料,在平衡之前产生7 942个实例。 输入量在该提交回合时进行测量,如果提交的诊断与地面真实性不同,则标签为标签。 正确的提交文件有标签 0 。 没有提交诊断的病例不会纳入这项任务。 因此,这一试验评估了利用提交时的状态来区分不正确和正确提交的能力。 之前的实验从等待检查站中分别衡量对未来行为的预测.

blocks.en: The feature definitions are the same for both tasks, with measurements taken at their respective prediction checkpoints. The progress baseline M0 uses the fraction of evidence received, t / T i t/T_{i} , the total evidence count T i T_{i} , and the number of candidates. M1 adds diagnostic confidence: the highest candidate probability, the difference between the two highest probabilities, and the entropy of the candidate distribution. These quantities summarize the certainty and concentration of the diagnostic belief distribution without identifying the correct candidate.
blocks.zh: 两项任务的特点定义相同,在各自的预测检查站进行测量。 进步基线M0使用收到的证据的一小部分,t / T i / T_{i},总证据计T i T_{i},以及候选人数. M1增加了诊断自信:候选人概率最高,两种最高概率的差,以及候选人分布的 en. 这些数量总结了诊断性信仰分布的确定性和集中性,而没有确定正确的候选人。

blocks.en: M2 supplements M0 with the original EVM features. These describe diagnosis submission propensity, its relationship to diagnostic confidence, and changes in beliefs across consecutive turns. Submission propensity is the probability of choosing answer rather than wait under the action probe. Its turn-to-turn change captures whether the model becomes more inclined to submit as new evidence arrives. The remaining features compare submission propensity with confidence and entropy and summarize fluctuations in confidence, probability margin, and entropy. At the first turn, change features are set to zero. M3 combines the inputs of M1 and M2. Neither M1 nor M3 uses the sufficiency annotation, submission lead time, or the identity of the correct diagnosis.
blocks.zh: M2补充剂 M0带有最初的EVM特性. 这些描述的是诊断呈报倾向性,它与诊断信心的关系,以及不同周期间信仰的变化。 提交倾向是选择答案而不是在动作探测器下等待的概率. 它的转弯变化捕捉模型是否随着新证据的到来而更倾向于提交. 其余特征是将提交倾向性与置信度和py度进行比较,并总结置信度、概率率和 en度的波动。 在第一个转弯时,更改特性设置为零. M3结合了M1和M2的投入. M1和M3都没有使用充分性注释,提交准备时间,也没有使用正确诊断的身份.

blocks.en: For next-turn submission, M prop M_{\mathrm{prop}} uses only submission propensity to examine how much predictive information is already present in the action probability. For submission errors, we additionally report M timing M_{\mathrm{timing}} , which adds the annotated lead time t i ∗ − τ i t_{i}^{*}-\tau_{i} to M0, where τ i \tau_{i} is the first submission turn. An oracle reference adds the probability of the ground-truth diagnosis to M1. These two references quantify the information provided by the annotated boundary and answer key, respectively. Their privileged inputs are separate from the M1–M3 comparison.

blocks.en: Case identifiers are assigned deterministically to 20% training, 20% validation, and 60% test partitions using seed 2027. All checkpoints belonging to a case remain in the same partition, and the assignment is shared across predictor specifications. Within each partition and task, we then undersample the majority class to match the minority class using the same seed. Examples are neither duplicated nor moved between partitions. Each retained partition therefore contains equal numbers of positive and negative examples, and competing predictors are evaluated on the same retained examples.
blocks.zh: 案件识别器被定型分配到20%的培训,20%的验证,60%的测试分区使用2027种子. 属于某一案件的所有检查站都在同一分区内,任务由预测器规格分担。 在每一个分区和任务中,我们先对多数阶层进行抽样,以便用同样的种子来匹配少数阶层. 实例既不重复,也不在分区之间移动。 因此,每个保留分区包含相同数目的正反例子,对相互竞争的预测器进行相同的保留例子评价。

blocks.en: Balancing is applied separately to submission versus waiting in the first task and incorrect versus correct submissions in the second. This prevents the majority class from dominating the reported probability losses and provides a common class proportion across models. The reported log losses consequently evaluate probabilities under this balanced sampling distribution. The original checkpoint counts describe the available support before undersampling, rather than the size of the balanced test sets.
blocks.zh: 在提交和等待第一项任务时分别适用平衡,在提交与正确之间分别适用平衡。 这使得多数类无法主导所报告的概率损失,并提供了不同模型的共同类别比例。 因此,所报告的原木损失根据这种均衡的抽样分布来评估概率。 最初的检查站计数描述的是在进行不足抽样之前可用的支持,而不是平衡测试集的大小.

blocks.en: Natural Gate tests whether allowing models to receive sufficient evidence improves their final diagnosis outcomes, as reported in Section 5 . For each LLM, the intervention includes every case in which the original natural run submits a diagnosis before t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} . Selection depends on submission timing, so it includes both correct and incorrect premature diagnoses. Before t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} , an attempted diagnosis submission is blocked from terminating the case, and the next evidence item is delivered. The blocked diagnosis is omitted from the subsequent conversation history, while ordinary wait responses are retained. In this way, the gate implements continued waiting without feeding the blocked diagnosis back to the model.

blocks.en: Once the evidence item at t i ∗ t_{i}^{*} has been delivered, the gate is removed. If the model continues waiting through the complete evidence sequence, the case ends without a submitted diagnosis. blocks.zh: 表A10和A11显示,在两种方法下,较宽的窗口将更多的提交材料归类为及时提交。 EVD-Harness仍然将更多诊断放在t i 的附近, 因此,当允许充分边界改变一两个转弯时,其时间优势依然存在。

blocks.en: The tolerance analysis reclassifies submission timing without changing any action or final diagnosis. blocks.en: A5.3 Separating Knowledge, Verification, and Context Effects
blocks.zh: A5.3 知识、核实和背景效果分离

blocks.en: To separate the contributions of CDW knowledge and evidence verification, we compare four named settings on the same 200 MedEVM cases. Each setting uses the same patient evidence, candidate diagnoses, evidence order, harness execution protocol, and two-action history window. The Full setting supplies CDW knowledge to Answer Proposal and Evidence Witness . The Submission Controller then follows the witness verdict to submit or wait. The − - CDW setting removes retrieved knowledge while retaining verification and submission control. The − - Witness setting retains CDW but submits the diagnosis proposed by Answer Proposal directly, without calling Evidence Witness . The Both setting removes CDW and witness review together. The compact header − - W abbreviates witness removal. Incorrect diagnoses and non-answers count as failures in every setting.
blocks.zh: 为了区分CDW知识和证据核实的贡献,我们比较了相同200个MDEVM案件中四个命名设置. 每个设置都使用相同的病人证据,候选诊断,证据命令,利用执行协议,以及双行动历史窗口. 全面设置提供CDW知识 回答建议和证据证人。 然后由提交书管理员跟踪证人的裁决提交或等待。 CDW设置在保留核查和提交控制的同时删除检索到的知识。 - 证人环境保留CDW,但直接提交答复建议提出的诊断,而不传唤证据证人。 两种设置一起删除CDW和证人的检讨. 紧凑标题 - - W 缩写为证人清除. 不正确的诊断和不回答在每个场合都算作失败.

blocks.en: In addition to retrieving knowledge and verifying diagnoses, the harness changes how many of its earlier wait and diagnosis-submission actions the model can see. We examine whether this shorter action record affects diagnostic outcomes and whether the harness execution procedure contributes separately. The Natural setting is the original LLM-only procedure with the complete patient record and prior actions. Short uses the same prompt and response processing and retains all patient evidence, but shows only the two most recent actions. Direct also shows two actions, while using the harness response format, parsing, and state updates to submit diagnosis proposals directly. None of these settings retrieves CDW knowledge or calls Evidence Witness , so the two successive comparisons examine the visible action record and execution procedure in turn.
blocks.zh: 除了获取知识和核实诊断之外,这种利用方式还改变了模型所能看到的早期等待和诊断提交行动的数量。 我们审查这种较短的行动记录是否影响诊断结果,以及利用执行程序是否单独作出贡献。 自然设定(Natural setting)是原始的LLM-唯一程序,具有完整的患者记录和前期动作. 肖特使用相同的即时反应处理,并保留所有患者证据,但只显示最近的两个动作. Direct还显示两个动作,同时使用利用响应格式,解析,以及状态更新直接提交诊断建议. 这些设置都没有检索到CDW的知识或呼叫证据证人,因此连续两次的比较都依次检查可见的行动记录和执行程序.

blocks.en: A5.4 Sensitivity to Evidence Perturbations
blocks.zh: A5.4 对证据的敏感性

blocks.en: We evaluate robustness on MedEVM using the evidence interventions associated with RQ3 and RQ4 , with implementation details in Appendix A3 . Each case is run with its original evidence sequence and with the corresponding perturbed sequence. The ground-truth diagnosis and candidate set remain fixed. Evidence reordering changes the presentation order of the same clinical information. The insertion conditions add repeated evidence, irrelevant text, or a paraphrase of existing evidence. Repeated and paraphrased evidence restate information already present, while irrelevant text adds no information that distinguishes the diagnostic candidates.
blocks.zh: 我们利用与RQ3和RQ4相关的证据干预措施,评估MDEVM的稳健性,其实施细节见附录A3。 每个案件都有其原始证据序列和相应的扰动序列。 地面真实诊断和候选人组合保持不变。 证据重排会改变相同临床信息的呈现顺序. 插入条件增加了重复证据,不相关的文字,或现有证据的释义. 重复的和被诠释的证据重复了已经存在的信息,而不相关的文本没有增加任何区分诊断候选人的信息.

blocks.en: For these experiments, we compare the final outputs of the original and perturbed diagnosis trajectories using the diagnosis outcome disagreement defined in Appendix A2.3 . A flip occurs when the submitted diagnoses differ or when only one trajectory submits a diagnosis. Two unanswered trajectories count as agreement. Table A16 compares LLM only and EVD-Harness under each insertion condition and reports their means across the three conditions. Results for evidence reordering appear in the Order flip column of Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 对于这些实验,我们利用附录A2.3所界定的诊断结果分歧来比较原始和扰动诊断轨迹的最终结果。 当提交的诊断结果不同,或者当只有一个轨道提交诊断结果时,就会发生翻转。 两个未解的轨迹算作一致. 表A16只比较每个插入条件下的LLM和EVD-Harness,并在三个条件中报告其手段. 重新排列证据的结果载于表4的顺序翻转栏。

blocks.en: Table A16: Answer-flip rates under evidence insertions (%, lower is better). Each method is evaluated under the same three perturbations. Mean denotes the average across conditions. Bold marks the lower rate in each paired comparison.
blocks.zh: 表A16: 国家 在插入证据时的回答率(%,更低)。 每种方法都在同一三个扰动下进行评估。 平均值指各种条件的平均值。 粗体标出每对比较中较低的率.

blocks.en: EVD-Harness consistently reduces answer flips across repeated evidence, irrelevant text, and paraphrased evidence (Table A16 ). Rates fall from 8.3–31.7% with LLM only to 1.1–3.8% with the harness. Averaged across the three conditions, the reduction ranges from 74% to 96% relative to LLM only. The improvement therefore extends across both repetition and changes in wording, supporting greater stability of diagnosis outputs when additional text supplies no new diagnostic information.
blocks.zh: EVD-Harness一贯减少重复证据、无关文字和被诠释的证据的回答翻转(表A16)。 比率从只有LLM的8.3–31.7%下降到只有LLM的1.1–3.8%。 平均而言,这三个条件的减少幅度仅为74%至96%。 因此,改进既包括重复,也包括修改措辞,支持在补充文本不提供新的诊断信息时,提高诊断产出的稳定性。

blocks.en: We also evaluate misleading evidence using the 318 paired cases described in RQ4 . Each pair varies the strength of evidence favoring a designated incorrect diagnosis while retaining the underlying case and subsequent corrective evidence. The Target error column of Table 4 reports submission of that incorrect diagnosis before corrective evidence arrives in the high-strength condition. EVD-Harness reduces this error rate relative to LLM only for all five models. This result complements the insertion experiments by showing improved resistance to evidence that actively favors a wrong diagnosis, in addition to reduced sensitivity to redundant or irrelevant text.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用RQ4中描述的318对案例评估误导性证据。 每对证据的强度不同,倾向于指定错误的诊断,同时保留基本案例和随后的纠正证据。 表4的目标错误栏报告,在纠正证据到达高强度状态之前,会提出不正确的诊断。 EVD-Harness只针对所有5种模型,相对LLM降低这个错误率. 这一结果补充了插入实验,除了对冗余或不相关的文本的敏感性降低外,还显示出对积极倾向于错误诊断的证据的抗药性得到提高.

blocks.en: A5.5 Transfer to Static Medical Question Answering
blocks.zh: A5.5 转到静态医疗问题回答

blocks.en: Static medical question answering tests whether the benefit of EVD-Harness extends beyond deciding when to answer during progressive evidence disclosure. In this setting, all question information is available from the outset. Improvements must therefore come from how the model uses that information to select and verify a diagnosis. We evaluate the same five models on DiagnosisArena-MCQ and MedXpertQA-Text, with results in Table A18 .
blocks.zh: 静态医学问题回答测试EVD-Harness的好处是否超越了在逐步披露证据时决定何时回答的范围. 在此情况下,所有问题信息从一开始就可以获取。 因此,改进必须来自模型如何利用这种信息来选择和核实诊断。 我们评价诊断阿雷纳-MCQ和MedXpertQA-Text的同样五个模型,结果见表A18。

blocks.en: Table A17: DiagnosisArena-MCQ accuracy (%). Direct sampling aggregates the indicated number of independently generated answers. The single-sample column is LLM only. Bold marks the highest accuracy for each model.
blocks.zh: 表A17:诊断阿雷纳-MCQ精度(%)。 直接取样汇总了所指明的独立生成的答案数目。 单采样柱只有LLM. 粗体标出每个模型的最高精度.

blocks.en: Each model receives the complete question and its answer candidates in a single turn. The LLM-only baseline directly selects an answer. EVD-Harness treats the question as the available patient record and applies CDW retrieval, Differential Guidance, Answer Proposal, and Evidence Witness before diagnosis submission. The witness uses the same question information to assess the proposal, and its citations are checked against that information. A question with no authorized answer counts as incorrect. Accuracy therefore includes all questions for both methods. Since no further clinical evidence is disclosed, this evaluation uses accuracy without assigning a sufficiency boundary or measuring premature submissions.
blocks.zh: 每种模式都以单次获得完整的问答候选人. LLM 唯一的基线直接选择一个答案. EVD-Harness将这个问题视为现有的病人记录,并在诊断提交前应用CDW检索,区别指导,回答建议和证据证人. 证人使用同样的问题信息来评估提案,其引用根据该信息进行核对。 一个没有经过授权回答的问题算作不正确。 因此,准确性包括两种方法的所有问题。 由于没有披露进一步临床证据,本评价采用准确性,而没有划定充分界限或衡量过早提交。

blocks.en: Table A18: All-sample accuracy (%) on DiagnosisArena-MCQ and MedXpertQA-Text. Unanswered questions count as errors. Bold marks the better method for each model and benchmark.
blocks.zh: 表A18: 诊断阿雷纳-MCQ和MedXpertQA-Text上的全样本精度(%). 未回答的问题算作错误。 粗体标出每个模型和基准的更好的方法。

blocks.en: To test whether gains on static QA arise from diagnostic knowledge, verification, or simply generating more answers, we compare a single direct answer, five or six independent answer samples, Full EVD-Harness , and two component removals on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (Table A17 ). Direct sampling selects the most frequent label from the same complete question. Ties follow a fixed label order, and invalid labels result in an unanswered, incorrect item. The − - Witness condition retains CDW retrieval and diagnosis proposals but submits each proposal without witness review. The − - CDW condition retains witness review but removes retrieved knowledge. All conditions receive the complete question at once.
blocks.zh: 为了检验静态质量保证的收益是来自于诊断知识、核实,还是仅仅生成更多的答案,我们比较了单一的直接答案、5或6个独立答案样本,即Full EVD-Harness,以及DisagnosisArena-MCQ上的两个组件清除(表A17)。 直接采样从同一个完整问题中选择最频繁的标签. 捆绑遵循固定的标签顺序,无效的标签导致一个未回答,错误的项目. 证人条件保留CDW检索和诊断建议,但每份建议都未经证人审查。 - - - CDW条件保留了证人审查,但删除了检索到的知识。 所有条件都同时收到完整的问题.

blocks.en: Table A17 shows that CDW-guided diagnosis proposals without witness review attain the highest DiagnosisArena-MCQ accuracy for each model. Removing CDW lowers the Full result, demonstrating the value of retrieved differential knowledge when the entire question is available at once. On MedXpertQA-Text, Full EVD-Harness improves over LLM only for all five models (Table A18 ). These results show that CDW-supported diagnosis also transfers to static medical QA.
blocks.zh: 表A17显示,CDW指导诊断建议未经证人审查,每个模型的诊断准确度最高。 删除 CDW 降低全部结果, 当整个问题同时可用时, 显示检索到的差分知识的价值 。 在MedXpertQA-Text上,Full EVD-Harness仅对所有5种型号改进LLM(表A18). 这些结果显示,CDW支持的诊断也转移到静态医疗QA.
